optimizedDescription.value: Declarative extractor engine selects AST nodes and produces simple, grouped, or structured content with injected transforms.

optimizedContext.value:
# Content extraction
## Rules
- Extractor: selector required; extract content default, label, or both; optional capture, strip, groupBy label, transform string or { name, args? }, fields FieldMapping.
- extract label = node.label; content = children only, leaf self; both = label + full subtree.
- Simple no fields/groupBy: find selector nodes, extract, strip, capture each regex match as $1 (placeholders $0/$2+), transform each emitted value, return Promise<string[]>.
- groupBy label: strip label group key; each item is child content.
- fields: one StructuredExtraction per match. FieldMapping from content default, label, parentLabel or childSelector; childSelector overrides from; optional capture, strip, followSiblings, transform.
- parentLabel uses nearest ancestor; childSelector resolves within match. followSiblings activates sequential child walk for every childSelector field: matching field becomes active; compatible following siblings append until mismatch/new field; capture yields $1 else full text.
- SubtreeRenderer only renderSubtree(node); caller supplies parser-compatible renderer. Engine uses SelectorNode, not ArtifactNode.
- Transform registry injected by caller; callback receives value, interpolated readonly args, opaque ReadonlyMap context; returns string or Promise<string>. Await async transforms.
- Unknown transform, execution failure/rejection, or null returned after received value throws ExtractorTransformError; identifies transform level and field when applicable.
- Kernel owns built-in registry plus additive external transforms. resolveSpecPath tries value then interpolated args in order for canonical spec ID.
## Constraints
- Engine no I/O/side effects; awaited work only injected transforms.
- from and childSelector exclusive; followSiblings ineffective without childSelector.
- Transform args declarative; placeholders can become undefined. Engine neither validates nor interprets context.
